channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Rutte defends US SACEUR role as Europe takes lead
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said Defence Ministers concluded a productive meeting in Brussels, describing the atmosphere as a turning point for the Alliance. The post Rutte defends US SACEUR role as Europe takes lead first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russia has suffered 1.3 million casualties in Ukraine
item.description: Russia has suffered around 1.3 million casualties since launching its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, including around 400,000 in 2025 alone, a senior NATO official told journalists at NATO Headquarters. The post Russia has suffered 1.3 million casualties in Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Most powerful warship on Earth heading to Iran
item.description: The United States is redeploying the aircraft carrier USS Gerald R. Ford from the Caribbean Sea to the Middle East, in a move that will place two US carrier strike groups in the region amid renewed tensions with Iran. The post Most powerful warship on Earth heading to Iran first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American warship collides with supply vessel
item.description: The US Navy guided-missile destroyer USS Truxtun has collided with the fast combat support ship USNS Supply during an underway replenishment. The post American warship collides with supply vessel first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: America is stocking up on massive bunker busters
item.description: The MOP is one of the largest conventional bombs in the US inventory, weighing around 30,000 pounds and developed specifically for penetrating reinforced underground facilities. The post America is stocking up on massive bunker busters first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain accelerating hypersonic missile development
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a new £12 million contract aimed at accelerating development of a sovereign UK hypersonic missile capability. The post Britain accelerating hypersonic missile development first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK set to increase spending on long-range missiles
item.description: The UK will spend more than GBP 400 million this financial year on long-range precision and hypersonic weapons, as the government moves to scale up joint missile development programmes with key European allies. The post UK set to increase spending on long-range missiles first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Labour MP calls for NATO ‘neighbourhood’ model for decisions
item.description: Graeme Downie MP says the NATO consensus model is too slow for modern crises and should adopt a "neighbourhood" approach, empowering regional allies like the UK to act fast and deny Russia the chance to exploit delays. The post Labour MP calls for NATO ‘neighbourhood’ model for decisions first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: World’s largest drone fleet deployed to deter Russia
item.description: NATO says it deployed the world's largest unmanned fleet in the Baltic, operating 50 drones before the US added another 20, as a cheaper and more sustainable alternative to using frigates for constant patrols. The post World’s largest drone fleet deployed to deter Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Rutte in Munich: Europe stepping up to lead NATO
item.description: Speaking at the Munich Security Conference, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said allies are undergoing a "real shift in mindset", with Europe taking greater responsibility for defence. #MSC2026 The post Rutte in Munich: Europe stepping up to lead NATO first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
